title: Evidence Is Not Authority
finding: Verified execution evidence does not imply permission to deploy; authorization must bind authenticated principal, exact proposal/diff/scope, quorum, validity window, and replay-resistant nonce.
permit: V AND I AND B AND Q AND W AND N

predicates.V: execution evidence verifies against exact tested commit and policy
predicates.B: approval binds proposal ID, diff SHA-256, and declared scope
predicates.Q: approval quorum and role policy satisfied
predicates.W: approval is within validity window and maximum age
predicates.N: nonce unused and atomically consumed by durable replay store

crossRepositoryFindings.GreatScale: execution evidence and policy-bound verification; no hosted pass claimed
crossRepositoryFindings.CycleKernal: PR #4 proposes state-aware demotion; full checkout tests unverified
crossRepositoryFindings.TrainLLM: random trust score > 0.8 can approve proposal; must not substitute for authenticated authorization

limits: Pure structural gate does not authenticate identity or verify signatures
Nonce consumption must be atomic and durable outside the pure function
A confidence score is not an authorization credential
Tested-commit identity and pull-request source-head identity must remain separate
Full repository tests, hosted CI, build, and deployment remain unverified
